## Description

Training: Today, Patient 360, nurse intake and handoff, note writing, coding, reconciliation, signing and addenda, Rx authorisation and printing, orders, referrals, what never happens automatically. Quick reference card for doctors and nurses.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** All pilot doctors and nurses trained; attendance recorded.
- [ ] **AC2.** Quick reference cards available at each workstation.
